title: OrgDevice.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe an organization device resource.

Apple Business API 2.6+

> **Note:** When additional attributes are added by Apple, they appear automatically, without requiring a newer version of the API.

addedToOrgDateTime.description: The date and time of adding the device to an organization.

ethernetMacAddress.description: The device’s built-in Ethernet MAC addresses.

isMdmMigrationCapable.description: Whether the device is eligible for device management service migration.

mdmMigrationDeadlineDateTime.description: The deadline, in ISO 8601 format, by which the device needs to complete its device management service migration, if a migration has been requested.

mdmMigrationStatus.description: The device’s current device management service migration state, if a migration has been requested.

orderDateTime.description: The date and time of placing the device’s order.

orderNumber.description: The order number of the device.

partNumber.description: The part number of the device.

productFamily.description: The device’s Apple product family: `iPhone`, `iPad`,`Mac`, `AppleTV`, `Watch`, or `Vision`

purchaseSourceId.description: The unique ID of the purchase source type: Apple Customer Number or Reseller Number

purchaseSourceType.description: The device’s purchase source type: `APPLE`, `RESELLER`, or `MANUALLY_ADDED`

releasedFromOrgDateTime.description: The date and time the device was released from an organization. This will be null if the device hasn’t been released. Currently only querying by a single device is supported. Batch device queries aren’t currently supported for this property.

status.description: The devices status: ASSIGNED or UNASSIGNED. If ASSIGNED, use a separate API to get the information of the assigned server.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time of the most-recent update for the device.
